This has led me to struggles in trying to get him involved in a wide range of parties and events, I remember practically begging him to be involved with the dual wedding of my two sisters; where I begged him to at least attend the event and make small talk the guests and the grooms, he did at least attend, but he sat in the corner drinking a beer, brooding over I don't know what.
